reason: 该插件主要用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页端界面个性化，用户可在新增的“个性化”设置中调整侧边栏 Logo、空对话欢迎区内容与对话区背景图，并实时生效；结合其 `package.json` 的 DSH Web 客户端注入与补丁结构，可确认其核心是主题/布局级 UI 增强。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 网页端插件，提供个性化设置入口，可修改侧边栏品牌标识、空对话欢迎区内容及对话背景，并在设置后立即生效。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that provides a personalization settings page to edit sidebar branding, empty-chat welcome content, and conversation background with immediate effect.

capabilities: Provides UI personalization settings for sidebar logo, welcome area logo/text, and conversation background.
Injects a web client settings page and applies style/DOM changes at runtime.
Observes DOM mutations to re-apply customizations after page rerender or navigation changes.
Accepts UI image inputs from local file upload (with client-side compression) or HTTPS URLs.
Persists custom settings in the DSH profile namespace and reapplies them from host settings.

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a DeepSeek Harness web GUI customization page for sidebar logo, empty-chat hero logo/text, and conversation background with live updates.

Repository metadata and package configuration show a dsh bundle patch plus web client injection (`dsh.bundle.patch`, `dsh.client.inject`) and files `lib/index.js`/`lib/client.js` for runtime customization behavior.
README notes DOM targeting by stable selectors and MutationObserver-based reapplication, indicating direct front-end UI modification behavior and persistence under `customui` settings.
